roster.name: ITAY GALO
roster.bio:
“Music is all my life and it burns in my bones!”

After conquering all the top stages in the most luxurious nightclubs, he founded Atisuto with the dream of creating the perfect team of DJs that can provide perfect events.
From weddings to festivals, from small to enormous events, he will find a perfect musical solution for you.

Using his passion for music, love for people, years of experience and high professional standards, he created a musical atmosphere machine that fits everybody, anybody and anytime.

If there’s a rhythm that will make you dance, he will find it!
What rhythm do you want for your event?

roster.name: EVE HAKMON
roster.bio:
“Music is my Language”

He grew up on the DJ stages. “I just loved making people happy” he says modestly.
From birthday parties, to grandiose events with thousands of guests, he has seen it all. He keeps exploring the music in the world with great curiosity and passion.
He bewitches the atmosphere with musical charm that leaves you breathless and with strong desire to hear more sounds. He will find the rhythm to suit your soul in every moment of the event. He will find and play the perfect song that fits right in.

From the beginning until the end, after all stages of the event, you will notice and feel the accuracy and timing of a true professional. He will find the perfect rhythm for every situation.For him, every event is like his first and last, and he treats each one with the same seriousness.

What’s most important to him is to live in the present, here and now, and create unforgettable moments for the future.

roster.name: NOAM KOCHAV
roster.bio:
“There is nothing quite like a moment when a nostalgic hit plays with a rhythm, one you cant remain indifferent to”

From early childhood he fell in love with music.

.Started as the child prodigy who freely plays the guitar and piano

And when you know he’s the one on the music, get ready to pull out of the drawer in your head the strongest hits you’ve already forgotten and hear them like you’ve never heard them before and as part of an experience you’ve never experienced.

He does not believe that there are people on the planet who only like one style of music, and bet that it takes one event of his only – to make every person connect to a various types of music that he has never connected to before, and all thanks to an electrifying atmosphere, good people and music that you simply can’t help but dance to.

roster.name: SHAI ARGAMAN
roster.bio:
“The music will stop only until the last of the guests falls of his feet”

The classic story of the little kid who became acquainted with music by accident and fell in love.

From concerts in the living room for his family and performances for free at little local clubs, to long night performances in front of thousands of mesmerized people that keep dancing without looking at the time.

By giving special attention to the event owner’s requests combined with his unique perception of music, he makes each event unique and unlike any other event you have ever experienced.

roster.name: LIOR ZEEVI
roster.bio:
“Mainstream is all I want”

He started his journey at private events, slowly gaining momentum and producing music in his own unique style, until he established his place in Israel’s best weddings and clubs. Today, he stands as one of the most prominent DJs in Israel, filled with performances, productions, and festival appearances. He is known for his talent in organizing events with a professional touch and skillfully adjusting the music to suit the audience’s preferences.One of the things that excites him the most is playing at weddings, where he brings his electrifying energy and passion to create unforgettable moments.

roster.name: TA-YO
roster.bio:
The most important thing I believe in is being able to read the dance floor and give it” “exactly what it needs, to feel the crowd and keep the energy alive.

TA-YO has been a DJ for 9 years, and his love for music is something that cannot be described in words – it’s simply in his soul. He knows how to blend all music styles seamlessly and create an experience that’s unforgettable, ensuring the dance floor is always energized. TA-YO has performed in top clubs across Israel and Tel Aviv, as well as internationally, including a set in Mykonos before Against of Time. He also warmed up for Vini Vici at a massive event, which was one of the highlights of his career. TA-YO is a resident DJ in the Israeli hard techno scene with the production Radio Berlin, and he is not only a DJ but also a music producer who understands exactly what the dance floor needs to keep the party going. Every performance he delivers is a unique experience, where the crowd just can’t stop dancing.

roster.name: NIR ROZENBERG
roster.bio:
“Every event is a challenge – to make each and every person dance, and create an atmosphere that the audience will never experience again in their lives.”

After 18 years of experience in making people dance for long hours… even while sleeping, he can find the unique rhythm that will make your event unforgettable.

He’s an expert in a variety of different types of music, but his greatest specialty is conveying emotions and creating a vibe through music alone, and in his opinion, if the most unique and unforgettable experience you have had ever experienced in your life is not an event, you haven’t had the right person on the music.

roster.name: LIAV YEHUDA
roster.bio: As a DJ who thrives on the energy of the crowd, Liav specializes in mainstream music that gets everyone on their feet. Starting his journey at a young age, he has gained momentum and built a dedicated audience over the years. There’s nothing more exhilarating for Liav than seeing hands up and bodies moving to the beat, creating an electrifying atmosphere that makes every event unforgettable. Liav’s passion for music is driven by the emotional connection seen in the audience, and he strives to craft experiences where every song resonates deeply. Whether it’s a wedding, a club night, or a festival, Liav brings his unique style and infectious energy to ensure the dance floor is always alive and the memories last a lifetime.

roster.name: ITAY ITSHAKI
roster.bio:
Known as one of Israel’s finest DJs, Itay Itshaki has years of experience playing for diverse crowds in different genres. Armed with a broad musical knowledge and a deep love for the dancefloor, Itay has developed a long-standing career full of highs.

Highly in demand within the Israeli local scene, Itay is known for being a resident DJ of the biggest student festival Funjoya for ten years in a row and can be found at almost every major event in Israel, playing out in front of the biggest crowds the Israeli scene can offer with a setlist full of dynamic dance favourites.

Reading the audience is a sixth sense, and it is something that he can do meticulously alongside his perfect timing of finding just the right track to suit any vibe. Whether it’s a wedding, a festival or a corporate event – these skills are not exclusive to one area, having just as much experience in the wedding world aswell as the clubbing scene.

Itay’s ability to create the perfect atmosphere is what placed him at the forefront of the Israeli DJ scene. Bringing his wide knowledge of the music scene, genres and meticulous crowd reading skills to any wedding, club, private event or a festival.

Aside from this, Itay can be found warming up for dance music industry titans such as Hardwell, Don Diablo, Brooks and many, many more, armed with his ability to read crowds and adjust his sets accordingly like no other DJ.

roster.name: YAHAV BOAZ
roster.bio:
Yahav Boaz is an Israeli DJ & performer known for his high-energy sets, strong crowd connection, and a unique blend of mainstream, electronic & Afro house music.

With performances across Israel and internationally including Greece, Spain, Bulgaria, Mexico, and the United States. Yahav continues to build a distinctive sound and stage presence.

His sets combine powerful energy, smooth transitions, and an unforgettable dancefloor experience that keeps the crowd moving all night long.

roster.name: ROTEM ASHASH
roster.bio:
Rotem Ashash is one of the prominent names in Israel’s mainstream DJ scene, with over a decade of experience across clubs and events.

Over the years, he has performed in leading clubs throughout Israel, alongside extensive work in the events industry, including numerous weddings, private events, and corporate productions, where he has built a strong reputation for his precise crowd reading and full control of the dance floor energy.

Rotem specializes in creating a dynamic musical experience that blends current hits, timeless classics, and powerful remixes, all tailored to the crowd and the unique vibe of each event.

At weddings and private events, Rotem brings a combination of experience, musical precision, and personal connection, with the goal of creating a high-energy, packed dance floor from the first track to the last.

His ability to bridge the worlds of clubs and events allows him to turn every event into a true party experience.

roster.name: DALIT RECHESTER
roster.bio:
The radio was her world and it let her expand herknowledge and understanding of music. She studied music to a depth understanding.

With great intelligence and sensitivity she creates a deep bond between her and the audience. She calms you down on rush hour with great soothing music on the radio, and later on at night she makes you move like there’s no tomorrow.

Put her on stage and let her launch her musical fireworks.

roster.name: RON NARIZ
roster.bio:
“Maximum Energy, 100 percent love”

His origins are from the land of Samba.
He grew up in a family that loves music and rhythms are his way of life.
Since 9th grade, he has been making his audience enjoying great beats.

He knows how to use all factors for music as tools for magic.
There is no atmosphere he can not create!
Between the audience he creates a bridge.

roster.name: FayJ
roster.bio:
FayJ is an international DJ, model, actress, and multidisciplinary creative with over 13 years of experience in the global fashion and entertainment industries. She has walked in runway shows, led fashion productions, and appeared in commercials, TV shows and major campaigns, building a strong on-camera presence and a commanding runway identity.

Expanding her artistic path into music, FayJ developed a distinctive sound and stage persona. As a DJ, she delivers high-impact sets driven by rhythm, sensuality, and movement — blending cool, eclectic musical taste with infectious, dance-floor energy. Her performances are defined by strong stage presence, emotional connection, and an ability to read and elevate the crowd.

FayJ represents a new generation of cross-disciplinary artists — seamlessly merging fashion, performance, and music into one cohesive creative language.

roster.name: HARD TO TELL
roster.bio:
Masters of hypnotic grooves, Hard To Tell (HTT) – the dynamic duo of Roy & Roi – are experts at crafting compelling dance floor narratives. Their sound seamlessly blends elements from diverse musical landscapes, from Detroit techno and house to cold wave and new wave, incorporating breakbeat and electroid dynamics to create immersive club experiences that transcend conventional boundaries.

The pair’s compositions masterfully balance between ethereal dreamscapes and powerful, steel-clad rhythms, striking a perfect harmony between muscular functionality and hedonistic sophistication. Their talents caught the attention of Innervisions founders Dixon and Âme, who featured their anthemic track ‘Area 88’ on Secret Weapons 15, followed by the Italo-influenced ‘Last Forever’ on volume 16 of the series. HTT’s productions have become staples in the Innervisions family repertoire and have garnered consistent praise from French legend Laurent Garnier.

Since their individual debuts over a decade ago and the formation of HTT in 2018, Roy and Roi have evolved significantly both artistically and personally. Their releases on respected labels such as Sums Over Histories, Siamese, and Tau (home to their ‘Love Pedal’ EP) showcase their distinctive musical DNA and demonstrate an impact that sets them apart in today’s crowded electronic music landscape.

Their expertise truly shines in their marathon sets, ranging from 5 to 10 hours, where their expansive musical vision adapts seamlessly to both intimate venues and large-scale warehouse environments. This versatility has earned them spots at numerous prestigious clubs and festivals worldwide, with regular appearances in cultural hubs including Berlin, Barcelona, Lisbon, Baku, Limassol, Ibiza, Mykonos, Milan, and Tel-Aviv.

live.bio:
Eilon Hazan is an Israeli guitarist and live performer specializing in Live on DJ shows, blending live guitar with techno, house, and psy-trance while focusing on energy and connection with the crowd.

He has performed at festivals and clubs across South America including Peru, Brazil, and Colombia  as well as extensively in Israel. Alongside his electronic work, he collaborates as a session guitarist with leading Israeli artists such as Nadav Hanzis, Bar Tzabari, and Noam Kleinstein.

His performances are defined by strong stage presence, professionalism, and a clear goal: keep the dancefloor moving.
